toolDefinitions.name: list_pricing_data
toolDefinitions.description: Discover local product IDs/names and available channel rule IDs with provenance. Choose only a matching record; clarify ambiguity.

toolDefinitions.name: get_product
toolDefinitions.description: Read product costs (BRL, grams, hours, kW) and provenance. Null is unknown.

toolDefinitions.name: get_channel_rule
toolDefinitions.description: Read separate revenue charge rates, fixed fee, source and validity. No Shopee rules exist.

toolDefinitions.name: calculate_scenarios
toolDefinitions.description: Deterministic C# costs and prices. Margins and discount are fractions. Uses stored product/rule, never model-invented costs. Includes undiscounted and discounted scenarios.

toolDefinitions.name: submit_recommendation
toolDefinitions.description: Submit a draft referring only to successful scenario IDs. No prices are applied. Human approval is required.

toolDefinitions.name: request_clarification
toolDefinitions.description: Stop and ask specific questions when essential data/rules/objectives are missing.

data.summary: Draft pricing comparison for headset-stand as of 2026-10-24 using synthetic demonstration data. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount on the charged price. Undiscounted recommendations: BRL 38.10 (20%), BRL 44.45 (30%), BRL 53.34 (40%). Discounted charged prices: BRL 34.29, BRL 40.01, BRL 48.01 respectively. Discount reduces realized revenue margin below target in each discounted case.
assumptions: Synthetic demonstration product and rule were used and are explicitly not confirmed business data.
All revenue-based charges in the channel rule are applied on the gross charged price; rule has 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provisioning is included using the product's stated failure rate and assumes full-print retry on failure.
Prices and margins are rounded by the deterministic calculation tool; minor rounding differences are expected.
limitations: Marketplace verification is not available; no current Shopee fees are used.
Full-print retry assumption may differ from actual operational recovery.
Discounted scenarios do not retain the requested target margin in any of the three cases.

recommendation.summary: Draft pricing comparison for headset-stand as of 2026-10-24 using synthetic demonstration data. Compared target revenue margins of 20%, 30%, and 40% with a 10% discount on the charged price. Undiscounted recommendations: BRL 38.10 (20%), BRL 44.45 (30%), BRL 53.34 (40%). Discounted charged prices: BRL 34.29, BRL 40.01, BRL 48.01 respectively. Discount reduces realized revenue margin below target in each discounted case.
assumptions: Synthetic demonstration product and rule were used and are explicitly not confirmed business data.
All revenue-based charges in the channel rule are applied on the gross charged price; rule has 10% channel fee, 0% tax, 0% advertising, and BRL 2 fixed fee.
Failure provisioning is included using the product's stated failure rate and assumes full-print retry on failure.
Prices and margins are rounded by the deterministic calculation tool; minor rounding differences are expected.
limitations: Marketplace verification is not available; no current Shopee fees are used.
Full-print retry assumption may differ from actual operational recovery.
Discounted scenarios do not retain the requested target margin in any of the three cases.
